messages:
nina (partnerships): Quick heads-up: Datadog marketplace certification is asking for a "tracing best-practices" doc for our GPU appliance tile. They want clear guidance for air-gapped installs + a tiny demo dashboard. Can we scope this in 1 pager?

otto (obs): Yes. We should emphasize three things: limit trace ingestion, sanitize high-cardinality attributes (model ids, user ids), and provide an offline-forwarding pattern.

keiko (eng): FWIW the model server emits a noisy span per token in the logits path. We need a sanitize hook to drop token-level attributes before they hit OTLP. I can add a small middleware.

sara (solutions): For SI teams, add explicit steps: 1) configure collector to probabilistically sample, 2) enable tail-sampler for errors/latency, 3) strip or hash PII/model identifiers. Make the examples copy-paste.

dave (marketplace): Marketplace wants a 60-90s explainer and an attached dashboard JSON. Also request: clear statement about expected monthly trace volume under the default profile (approx numbers). Can you estimate?

keiko (eng): With default sample_rate=0.05 and max_traces_per_second=3 per host, rough estimate for our demo infra (4 hosts) => ~518k traces/month. Numbers can vary but include a 'high variance' note.

otto (obs): I'll craft the dashboard: trace ingestion rate, avg token-span duration, p95 inference latency, and a gauge for `redwood.trace.sample_rate`. Keep it lightweight.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach security checklist for marketplace tile (S3 artifacts signed, no secret keys in dashboard JSON).

nina (partnerships): Good call. Keiko, can the middleware hash model_name and user_id fields? Prefer deterministic hash so SIs can correlate across services.

keiko (eng): Yes. Pseudo: `attrs['model_id'] = sha256(attrs['model_id']).hexdigest()`. Will add opt-out via `REDWOOD_TRACE_PII_HASHING=false`.

sara (solutions): For air-gapped: propose collector writes traces to local file in ndjson, then a small forwarder container which retries to Datadog when network available. Provide systemd unit example for on-prem.

keiko (eng): Draft forwarder (bash):

```bash
while true; do
  for f in /var/otlp/out/*.ndjson; do
    curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "DD-API-KEY: $DD_API_KEY" --data-binary "@$f" https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/v1/input && rm $f || sleep 30
  done
  sleep 60
done
```

otto (obs): Nice. Also include collector config snippet with a `file` exporter and `probabilistic` processor. Make sure the example uses env vars for keys.

nina (partnerships): Who will own the cert doc and the marketplace tile blurb? Dave you said marketplace needs the 90s explainer. Can you draft that and I will link to the tech quickstart.

dave (marketplace): I can draft the marketplace blurb and checklist. I'll need the dashboard JSON and the short usage estimate. Target Fri COB to submit.

keiko (eng): I'll open a PR with: middleware sanitize + hash, REDWOOD_TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE env, and the forwarder snippet in docs.

otto (obs): I'll put together the quickstart doc and the compact dashboard JSON; will include export instructions for SIs.

ops-bot: Preflight: ensure no hardcoded API keys in repo. Verified: no secrets found in current branch.

nina (partnerships): Ack. Action items: Dave = marketplace blurb, Otto = quickstart + dashboard JSON, Keiko = sanitize middleware + forwarder snippet, Sara = SI step-by-step and systemd unit, Nina = coordinate and submit. Please ack here.

keiko (eng): Ack. PR incoming.

dave (marketplace): Ack. Drafting blurb now.

sara (solutions): Ack. I'll test the forwarder with an air-gapped VM and share results.

otto (obs): Ack. Will include sample JSON sizes so marketplace numbers align.

nina (partnerships): Excellent. If nothing else we can close and reconvene after CI checks and PR reviews. :thumbsup:
